name: 大唐西游指间版
english_name: Great Tang Journey to the West (Zhijian edition)
english_description: A 2009 'Zhijian' (finger-tip / mobile-era) build of the Great Tang Journey to the West mudlib. The RAR is per-file encrypted; the archive comment itself prints the password (QQ group 676036579). Converted from GB18030 and assigned port 40267. Distinct from the empty-status GitHub dtxy clone and from dtxywzxzb.
